6:37 pm IDT (16:37 BST) — IDF completes Hezbollah infrastructure destruction in Mansouri
"The Israeli military says it has completed a large-scale operation to destroy Hezbollah infrastructure in the southern Lebanon town of Mansouri."
The military reports that forces of the 55th Reserve Paratroopers Brigade, working with the Yahalom Combat Engineering Unit, destroyed over 600 Hezbollah sites including eight tunnels. Troops also located dozens of rocket launchers left behind by Hezbollah before the ceasefire took effect.
